chain.note: Both trees follow the paper's route. They go from the scratch-restoring exchange and frames, to nested labels with L<N/2, to s_b<W_bm and s_c<W_cm, to the exponent tau=sigma=1-2^-50 via eta>20*2^-50. From there they reach the interchange recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and O(Vu^tau), and the layer recurrence and O(Vd^lambda'). These feed the transform layout costs, the convolution, resampling, chirp and cancellation, the six-step algorithm, exact recovery, and the margin min g_2=2^-181 giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). Neither chain breaks or thins where the other does not. B's extra step on negating the conjecture lies after the time bound.

errors.says: Three stages of forward invocations y_S->y_S+x_S send (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: Stages 1 and 3 are forward invocations from X to Y, but stage 2 runs the inverse forward schedule from Y to X (X<-X-Y); three forward invocations would not give the exchange. A's own S2.1.7 states the correct route.

errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero residual is nonalternating because it contains a norm-one coordinate vector outside the supports of the earlier tensor vectors.
errors.paper: Coordinate units are found only in the factors B, Q^perp, triple complements and full spaces. The lines P and Q contribute their own norm-one tensor vectors, and the norm-one vector of a residual is the tensor of these, e.g. in P(x)t_X^perp. It is not in general a coordinate vector.

errors.says: Every nonzero residual contains a norm-one vector, so it is nondegenerate and nonalternating.
errors.paper: Nondegeneracy of each residual follows from the orthogonal decompositions; the norm-one vector only shows it is nonalternating.

overall.reason: Neither plan has a major error and the central chains coincide, so the verdict rests on completeness within derivations. B carries checklist sub-steps that A lacks: L4's plane absorption and P3's k-column factorization. On core results B also carries steps A omits: the omitted top position in the packed addition, the packed-call uniformity in the layer proof, the L-conjugated exact operators of the transform layout, the left inverse in resampling, and the conjugation step of the cancellation lemma. A is fuller on the frame invariant and on M1 of the matrix shear, and has one more minor misstatement than B.
